question: After the retry defect is repaired, should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in OTLP endpoint, probe signals, shared telemetry API, and privacy boundary as a supported core diagnostics surface?
rationale: Code review can verify the implementation and safety guardrails, but it cannot authorize a permanent telemetry settings, dependency, naming, and privacy contract for the product.

options.title: Adopt Bounded Diagnostics
options.body: Accept the opt-in core telemetry direction after adding an explicit retry path, with export disabled by default and restricted to the documented diagnostic boundary.

options.title: Keep Conventions Only
options.body: Retain naming and safety guidance while deferring exporter packages, persisted settings, UI, and runtime probes.

options.title: Decline Core Telemetry
options.body: Keep collector integration outside the companion app until a future maintainer-sponsored design exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt Bounded Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in core telemetry direction after adding an explicit retry path, with export disabled by default and restricted to the documented diagnostic boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Commit history most strongly connects this owner to the diagnostics, settings, App composition, and tray-test surfaces involved in the product choice.
